name: Binner
description: Groups a numeric column into integer bins by equal width, explicit custom edges, or equal-frequency NTILE buckets.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Name of the appended integer bin column.

method.title: Method
method.description: width uses equal intervals between min and max, custom uses explicit edges, frequency uses NTILE buckets.

bins.title: Bins
bins.description: Number of bins for the width and frequency methods.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Ascending bin boundaries for the custom method; n+1 edges define n bins.
